# Well Planned Journey

> > A comprehensive national park planning resource featuring detailed itineraries, gear guides, and travel tips for exploring America's most iconic destinations.

Well Planned Journey is a national park blog created by Julia Jones that provides travelers with practical guides for visiting major US national parks including Yellowstone, Glacier, Zion, Yosemite, Joshua Tree, and Redwood. The site combines detailed itineraries, outdoor gear recommendations, and trip planning resources to help visitors make the most of their national park adventures.

## Key Topics

- National Parks
- Itineraries
- Road Trips
- Trip Planning
- Hiking & Camping
- Gear Guides
- Yellowstone
- Yosemite National Park
- Zion National Park
- Glacier National Park
- Joshua Tree National Park
- Redwood National Park
- Travel Planning
- Outdoor Gear
- Bucket List Destinations
